LESSON: LISTEN TO

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listen to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Listen to. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate an understanding of a set of instructions through appropriate responses
2. demonstrate conventions of giving instructions and asking questions on instructions, questions, and possible responses in pairs, small groups and whole class.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate an understanding of a set of instructions through appropriate responses
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate an understanding of a set of instructions through appropriate responses. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate conventions of giving instructions and asking questions on instructions, questions, and possible responses in pairs, small groups and whole class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate conventions of giving instructions and asking questions on instructions, questions, and possible responses in pairs, small groups and whole class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Listen to.
2. Explain Listen to to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Listen to.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate an understanding of a set of instructions through appropriate responses
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Listen to. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Listen to important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate an understanding of a set of instructions through appropriate responses
2. demonstrate conventions of giving instructions and asking questions on instructions, questions, and possible responses in pairs, small groups and whole class.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
